hooks.text: 怪物永久死亡后以灵魂重生并继承成长
hooks.excerpt: If a monster dies in combat, you’ll lose it. Permanently. But you have the power to defy death by rebirthing their souls.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四种以太元素驱动回合制策略组合
hooks.excerpt: Manage and harness the four elements of Aether to unleash powerful spells. Consider your synergies and plan your monsters actions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 技能池会响应前序选择与当前队友
hooks.excerpt: Every monster has a dynamic skill pool that reacts to previous choices and other monsters you have in your team, enabling you to create powerful teams.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: The monster designs are cool, the music is fantastic, the art style is great, and the game feels like it has polish, it just needs to do way more of those things.

opinions.text: I remember watching the trailer and some YouTubers play the game, and thought I would really enjoy this, especially with how great the pixel art looked.

opinions.text: Boring, combat systems are way too complex and exhausting & in turn they discourage ya to try agen or play another run, the learning curve is very steep and the tutorial is convoluted as a result which the dev team should of identified very early on, if the tutorial is making players tap out, then obv ya either got too many systems at play too early or you've just outright made the game so complex that its not even approachable for beginners, (i did force myself to get through the tutorial & beat the end boss or whatever but it wasn't fun at all nd was annoying me nd boring me senseless) This
